pipeline.name: weekly-social-recycle
pipeline.description: Track 2 — Weekly evergreen article recycling for social media. Selects high-traffic articles not yet posted, creates social copy and images, schedules via hub.

parent.title: [{{date}}] Weekly social recycle
description: ## Weekly Social Recycle Pipeline
Select 2-3 evergreen articles for social media recycling.
Use analytics data to choose the best-performing formats and time slots.
Pipeline: Growth Analyst → Copywriter → Frontend Designer → Content Manager

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Social recycle — select articles
description: ## Select 2-3 evergreen articles for social recycling
### Step 1 — Dedup
Check local drafts (`node social-draft.mjs list --json`) and Postiz posts to build the already-posted set.
Exclude articles published within the last 14 days.
### Step 2 — Analytics
Run `node social-draft.mjs performance-report --json` to identify the best-performing format.
### Step 3 — Selection
Use SerpBear/Umami to find top-traffic articles NOT in the already-posted set.
Select 2-3 candidates from ops/sales/marketing departments.
Prefer articles matching the best-performing format from Step 2.
### Step 4 — Format diversity
At least 1 of 2-3 selected articles should use a non-image post format (carousel, link-only, or document).
Check `performance-report --json` postFormatPerformance to avoid over-indexing on one format.
Use the format selection matrix from AGENTS.md to match article content to optimal format.
### Output
Comment on this task with the selected articles:
- Slug, title, department
- Recommended format (insight-stat / how-to / contrarian)
- Post format (image / carousel / link-only / document / text-only)
- Carousel template if applicable (key-takeaways / stat-highlight / step-by-step)
- Hook suggestion (most surprising stat or contrarian take)
- Suggested slots from `node social-draft.mjs suggest-slot --platform linkedin --json`

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Social recycle — write copy
description: ## Write social copy for recycled articles
Blocked on [{{recycle_select.identifier}}] — wait for article selection.
For each selected article:
1. Read the full article at `src/content/blog/<slug>.md`
2. Check the **post format** recommended in the selection task
3. Write LinkedIn copy — adjust length per format (see AGENTS.md format table)
4. Write Facebook copy — adjust length per format
5. If post format is `carousel` or `document`: also provide slide content JSON (see AGENTS.md)
6. If post format is `text-only`: write longer-form text (1200-1800 chars LinkedIn)
7. If post format is `link-only`: write shorter caption (400-600 chars LinkedIn)
8. Use the recommended format and hook suggestion from the selection task
Post copy (and slide JSON if applicable) in a comment, then reassign to Frontend Designer.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Social recycle — generate images
description: ## Generate assets for recycled articles
Blocked on [{{recycle_copy.identifier}}] — wait for copy.
Check the **post format** from the selection task. Then for each article:
### If post format = `image` (default)
1. Generate LinkedIn image (1200x630) and Facebook image (1080x1080)
2. Report CDN URLs and style names
### If post format = `carousel`
1. Use `generate-social-carousel.mjs` with slide JSON from Copywriter
2. Report comma-separated CDN URLs for Content Manager to use as `--media-urls`
### If post format = `document`
1. Use `generate-social-document.mjs` with slide JSON from Copywriter
2. Report PDF CDN URL for Content Manager to use as `--document-url`
### If post format = `video`
1. Use `generate-social-video.mjs` with article title and department
2. Report video CDN URL for Content Manager to use as `--media-urls`
### If post format = `link-only` or `text-only`
No assets needed. Comment 'No media generation needed' and reassign to Content Manager.
Post asset URLs in a comment, then reassign to Content Manager.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Social recycle — create drafts
description: ## Create social drafts in the hub
Blocked on [{{recycle_images.identifier}}] — wait for assets.
For each article, use the **post format** from the selection task:
1. Run `node social-draft.mjs suggest-slot --platform <platform> --json` for optimal time
2. Create drafts with format-specific flags (see AGENTS.md for full flag reference):
- `image`: `--post-format image --image-url <url>`
- `carousel`: `--post-format carousel --media-urls <url1>,<url2>,...`
- `link-only`: `--post-format link-only --article-url https://superdots.sh/blog/<slug>`
- `document`: `--post-format document --document-url <url>`
- `video`: `--post-format video --media-urls <url>`
- `text-only`: `--post-format text-only` (no media flags)
3. Include all metadata flags (--recommended-format, --hook-suggestion, --image-style, --issue-id)
4. Include `--issue-id` pointing to this parent pipeline task [{{_parent.identifier}}]
Close this task with: 'Drafts created. Luca: approve at cms.superdots.sh/social.'
